interactions.note: The affinity of epitope-specific AM14 Fab for binding to furin-cleaved RSV F ectodomains stabilized in the prefusion (DS-Cav1) or postfusion (F ΔFP) conformation was measured using a Luminex-based binding assay. AM14 bound tightly to prefusion RSV F derived from A and B subtypes with EC50s of 0.63 nM and 0.18 nM, respectively. In contrast, no binding to furin-cleaved postfusion F was detected.

interactions.assay: surface plasmon resonance (SPR) · dissociation constant KD
interactions.note: The affinity of epitope-specific AM14 Fab for binding to furin-cleaved RSV F ectodomains stabilized in the prefusion (DS-Cav1) or postfusion (F ΔFP) conformation was measured using a Luminex-based binding assay. AM14 bound tightly to prefusion RSV F derived from A and B subtypes with EC50s of 0.63 nM and 0.18 nM, respectively. In contrast, no binding to furin-cleaved postfusion F was detected.

interactions.assay: flow cytometry · qualitative binding
interactions.note: The epitope-specific AM14 mAb bound to a full-length prefusion F expressed on the surface of HEK293 cells. Binding of AM14 IgG to these cells expressing a F variant with monoclonal antibody-resistant mutation (MARM) N426D was reduced approximately four-fold. Binding of AM14 IgG to purified prefusion F N426D was reduced by approximately 100-fold in an ELISA.

interactions.assay: ELISA · qualitative binding
interactions.note: The epitope-specific AM14 mAb bound to trimeric prefusion F by ELISA.  Cleavage of RSV F was required for AM14 binding as AM14 failed to bind prefusion F with mutated furin sites. AM14 binding to monomeric F, composed of RSV F residues 1–524 and lacking the foldon trimerization motif, was reduced by nearly 100-fold compared to the prefusion F trimer. The residual monomer-binding activity may be due to transient trimerization at high concentrations, which would be indistinguishable from monomeric F binding in this assay.

interactions.assay: chromatography · qualitative binding
interactions.note: Binding of epitope-specific AM14 Fab was sufficient to stabilize trimeric prefusion F in the absence of a trimerization motif or stabilizing mutations. This was shown by the similar gel filtration elution profiles for purified prefusion, trimeric RSV F (DS-Cav1) incubated with excess Fab compared to complexes formed by co-expression of  Fab with RSV F ectodomain lacking foldon and stabilizing mutations.
